title: I Give You Thanks, O Lord

questions.question: I give you thanks, O Lord, with my whole what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:1 (ESV): "I give you thanks, O Lord, with my whole heart;"

questions.question: Before the gods I sing your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:1 (ESV): "before the gods I sing your praise;"

questions.question: I bow down toward your holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:2 (ESV): "I bow down toward your holy temple"

questions.question: And give thanks to your name for your steadfast love and your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:2 (ESV): "...and give thanks to your name for your steadfast love and your faithfulness,"

questions.question: For you have exalted above all things your name and your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:2 (ESV): "for you have exalted above all things your name and your word."

questions.question: On the day I called, you answered me; my strength of soul you did what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:3 (ESV): "my strength of soul you increased."

questions.question: All the kings of the earth shall give you thanks, O Lord, for they have heard the words of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:4 (ESV): "...for they have heard the words of your mouth,"

questions.question: And they shall sing of the ways of the Lord, for great is the glory of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:5 (ESV): "for great is the glory of the Lord."

questions.question: For though the Lord is high, he regards the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:6 (ESV): "For though the Lord is high, he regards the lowly,"

questions.question: But the haughty he knows from where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:6 (ESV): "but the haughty he knows from afar."

questions.question: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:7 (ESV): "Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life;"

questions.question: You stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and your right hand does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:7 (ESV): "and your right hand delivers me."

questions.question: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:8 (ESV): "The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me;"

questions.question: Your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever. Do not forsake the work of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 138:8 (ESV): "Do not forsake the work of your hands."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 138?

key_verse_text: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever. Do not forsake the work of your hands.
